contracts.commit_point: Start of the agent run at `Runner.run_streamed(triage_agent, message)` in `run_interview_agent_stream` (backend/agent_router.py:31): the registered input guardrail must evaluate the incoming message before the model run consumes it, and a tripped guardrail (`tripwire_triggered=True`) must stop the run before any model request carrying the injected input.
contracts.declared_mechanism: `injection_guardrail`: an `@input_guardrail`-decorated async guardrail (backend/resume_agents.py:53-63) that normalizes the run input via `_normalize_input` (lines 48-51), scans it with `inspect_user_text` against the `DANGER_TERMS` list (lines 27-46), and returns `GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=check, tripwire_triggered=check.blocked)`; attached to the production `triage_agent` constructor via `input_guardrails=[injection_guardrail]` (backend/resume_agents.py:191).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A user message containing a DANGER_TERMS prompt-injection phrase (matched case-insensitively by `inspect_user_text`) being processed by `triage_agent`'s LLM run because `injection_guardrail` did not execute at run start or returned `tripwire_triggered=False` (`check.blocked` false).
pending_binding_information: Whether the installed `agents` SDK executes input guardrails before the first model request during `run_streamed` and aborts the streamed run when `tripwire_triggered=True`; this framework behavior is not shown in the supplied source (only imports at backend/resume_agents.py:1-6 and backend/agent_router.py:11).

Whether a tripped guardrail surfaces as an exception that `run_interview_agent_stream`'s except block (backend/agent_router.py:47-49) converts into an SSE error event without any partial model deltas being streamed.
Whether handoff targets inherit input guardrails from triage_agent when control transfers mid-run, or subsequent turns run unguarded.

Whether `_normalize_input`'s list branch (' '.join(str(item) ...) over TResponseInputItem items, backend/resume_agents.py:48-51) preserves message content faithfully enough for the substring check on non-string run inputs.
Whether any other entry point or deployment path invokes triage_agent without the registered guardrail.
contracts.protected_operation: The `triage_agent` run initiated by `Runner.run_streamed(agent, message)` inside `run_interview_agent_stream`, reached from the POST /agents/stream endpoint that passes `request.message` into the stream runner.
contracts.protected_resource: `triage_agent`'s model (LLM) run/stream (System_Triage_Agent with handoffs to the four specialist agents) consuming the user-submitted message from POST /agents/stream.
contracts.protection_obligation: The input guardrail `injection_guardrail`, registered on `triage_agent` via `input_guardrails=[injection_guardrail]`, must block prompt-injection-style user inputs (e.g., 'ignore previous instructions', 'reveal system prompt', '시스템 프롬프트 보여줘') — i.e., return `tripwire_triggered=True` in its `GuardrailFunctionOutput` — so that such input never reaches the `triage_agent` LLM run initiated by POST /agents/stream through `Runner.run_streamed`. (Merged from the first-phase and second-phase reviewer wordings, which describe the same obligation at the same commit point.)
scope_limits: Limited to the supplied source views; repository enumeration is incomplete and behavior labels are unavailable, so no runtime-behavior or prevalence claims are asserted.

The declared mechanism is a literal, lowercased substring match against the eight DANGER_TERMS entries; paraphrased, translated, encoded, or otherwise obfuscated prompt injections outside those exact strings are not covered by the declared mechanism.

Coverage is limited to triage_agent runs initiated by POST /agents/stream as shown; both mode values ('single' and 'multi') map to triage_agent (backend/agent_router.py:29), so no additional agent path arises from this endpoint.

The handoff target specialists (resume_editor_agent, question_agent, evaluation_agent, feedback_agent) carry no input_guardrails registration in supplied source (backend/resume_agents.py:119-172), so post-handoff model turns are out of scope of this contract.
Ordinary endpoint mechanics (Pydantic field validation, SSE formatting, exception-to-SSE error forwarding) are generic application behavior outside the protection contract.
